text.text: *Topic:* How should we build our internal knowledge agent — a chatbot or a wiki?

*Outcome (bridged consensus):*
>Build the sourced wiki first; add a thin conversational layer on top.

*What majority-rule would have picked:*
>Ship the chatbot; people want a chat UI.
*Information uptake (this scenario):* after the evidence, the *chatbot* camp moved *+0.27* toward the compromise (the *wiki* camp was already there, *+0.03*). 3 of 5 participants moved.

elements.text: ⚠️ Uptake is a *scenario demonstration*, not data-validated. The bridging result IS validated on 6,605 real Habermas sessions (Phase A).
